scholarships.name: KAIST Scholarship (undergraduate)
scholarships.living_allowance: 350,000 KRW per month (plus medical health insurance)
scholarships.renewal: Students must maintain GPA over 2.7 out of 4.3 at KAIST after their freshman year
scholarships.application_period: Same as Admission Application (check 'KAIST scholarship' on Statement of Financial Resources)
scholarships.evidence: Eligibility Applicants of International Student Admission Subsidies Full tuition fee: tuition exemption for 8 semesters Living expenses: 350,000 KRW per month Medical Health insurance

scholarships.name: KAIST Scholarship (graduate)
scholarships.living_allowance: monthly stipend (dependent on research involvement; varies by college)
scholarships.application_period: Select the KAIST scholarship option in the application
scholarships.department_restriction: All departments except Global Technology Innovation Program (GDI-GTIP Track)
